description:
Location - Long Island,NY 
 Key Skills:   Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Microservices, Web Services
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 • Bachelors degree and 5+ years of hands–on experience developing applications using Java/J2EE and Web Services. 
 • Experience with Java 8 and Gemfire 
 • Experience implementing business critical, high volume, and highly available web-based applications is a must. 
 • Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD) and testing tools such as Junit and LeanFT. 
 • Experience with, or very knowledgeable in, cloud based development leveraging Cloud Foundry in PaaS environment. 
 • Familiar with git and RTC for source control 
 • Must be collaborative, adaptable, and have good communication skills. Prior experience working on agile teams is very desirable. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 • HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Responsive Web Design. 
 • Experience in the financial industry is a plus. 
 • Experience with layered architecture. esp. building micro services and connecting to API's. 
 • Experience with database schema design and JDBC 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
